says: RunnerOptions.chunk was optional, so the runner kept its own copy of mail.chunk's default (CHUNK = 64 * 1_024) beside the declaration in settings/Declarations.ts. Fixed in the same pull request by the fix round of 2026-11-15: RunnerOptions.chunk is required and is the setting's byte size, the runner's copy is gone, the brain passes the value it read at its edge, and test files pass the declaration's default. Runtime law modules may not read settings (the layer rules), so those that send no chunked mail pass a size of their own that no law depends on.
proof: Runner.ts:226 `const CHUNK = 64 * 1_024` and Runner.ts:531 `options.chunk ?? CHUNK`, beside Declarations.ts:227 `default: ByteSize.bytes(64 * KIB)`.
cost: A change to the declared default would leave every runner wired without the option on the old size.
